request.style: English, ancient Middle Eastern victory song, a fierce female voice with a women's chorus, frame drums, darbuka and riq, oud and ney, ululation, Hijaz mode, driving, 6/8, 126 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
When the leaders lead in Israel
When the people offer themselves willingly
Bless the Lord
Hear, O kings, give ear, O princes

[Chorus]
Awake, awake, Deborah
Awake, awake, sing a song
Arise, Barak, lead away your captives
Awake, awake, Deborah

[Verse]
Lord, when you went out from Seir
The earth trembled and the heavens poured
The mountains quaked before the Lord
The God of Israel

[Chorus]
Awake, awake, Deborah
Awake, awake, sing a song
Arise, Barak, lead away your captives
Awake, awake, Deborah
